title.narrative: Humanitarian Information Systems Strengthening evidence-based decision making in South Sudan (HARISS)

description.narrative: (1) Increased understanding and use of crisis-affected communities’ perceptions and experience of humanitarian activities to enable a community-centred approach in humanitarian programming (2) Increased understanding of movement barriers and displacement routes to inform humanitarian decision-making at the county and hotspot level (3) Improved, timely sub-national monitoring of needs and shocks across South Sudan (4) Provision of an evidence-based contextualisation of livelihood coping strategies indicators to improve food security analysis and evidence-based prioritisation of aid delivery in South Sudan (5) Increased understanding of the magnitude and severity of malnutrition and severity need classification for evidence-based decision making in designing and implementing nutrition programs (6) Improved and informed evidence-based decision-making around emergency prioritisation by the ICCG and clusters, and around cash and resilience programming
